prd:
### US-015: Password-reset tokens
- generateResetToken(length) returns a single-use token emailed to the user as a reset link.
- Tokens must be unguessable by an attacker who has observed prior tokens.
description: TypeScript twin of sec-04-predictable-token. Password-reset tokens are drawn with Math.random(). MDN's Math.random() reference states that it does not provide cryptographically secure random numbers and must not be used for anything related to security. V8 implements it with xorshift128+, whose state can be recovered from observed outputs, so an attacker who has seen prior tokens can predict later ones.
expected_fix: Use node:crypto: randomBytes(n).toString('base64url'), or crypto.randomInt(ALPHABET.length) for each character.
